mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS below 0.25%) indicates accommodative monetary policy that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.25%, or the Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 10.0% signals improving labor market conditions, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE falls below 10.0%, SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances, or the Rank IC for the signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates robust consumer demand and economic activity, which drives corporate revenue growth and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of declining industrial production (INDPRO below 95.0), supply chain disruptions are easing, leading to improved corporate margins and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO is below 95.0, SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances, or the Rank IC for the signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: High levels of housing starts (HOUST) indicate robust residential construction activity, which correlates with rising consumer confidence and corporate investment, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST is above the 50th percentile of its historical range, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate above 1.0% signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases discount rates and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When FEDFUNDS exceeds 1.0%, SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in unemployment (UNRATE) and increases in employment (PAYEMS) signal a tight labor market, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of declining UNRATE and rising PAYEMS fails to produce positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of active monetary policy easing (FEDFUNDS below 0.25%), the central bank's commitment to low rates supports equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When FEDFUNDS is below 0.25%, SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.
